target: Encrypted Field Collector queue persistence and automatic recovery after candidate Gateway outage

test_data.temporary_location_and_device: created with a single-use synthetic enrollment fixture after user approval

steps: Confirmed the browser vault was unlocked by the user and the queue was initially empty.
Stopped only the candidate app container; PostgreSQL and Metabase remained running.
Saved one synthetic note. The app showed 'Saved on this device. It will sync when online.' and a pending count of one.
Confirmed the candidate database had zero collections and zero sync logs for the fixture before Gateway recovery.
Restarted the candidate app and confirmed /health returned 200.
Did not press Sync now. After the app's background retry interval, the browser showed a zero pending badge and 'Everything is up to date'.
Confirmed one successful push in sync_log and one server collection. The collection remained ineligible with reason transport_pending.
Revoked the temporary device and transactionally deleted the synthetic location, device, enrollment, collection, and sync log; all guarded post-cleanup counts were zero.
Locked the browser vault. The encrypted device credential remains stored locally but is unusable because its server-side device was deleted.
limitations: The host network stayed available and the browser continued to report Online; this tests candidate Gateway service unavailability, not navigator.onLine=false or OS airplane mode.
Real OIDC, retired-form consent withdrawal in the browser, tenant/RLS, retention/erasure, durable media recovery, and human disposition remain open.
The accepted transport receipt does not verify, publish, or authorize use of the collection.

latest_browser_retest.scope: Candidate Gateway app outage and automatic browser reconnect; no OS network change

first_attempt.cause: Empty optional form fields were serialized as JSON null, which does not match their immutable string schema.
first_attempt.local_rejected_item: removed through the Field Collector queue UI before retry

latest_browser_retest.implementation_correction: The browser now omits empty form fields. The app image was rebuilt and only kokonut-kernel-candidate-app-1 was recreated; the candidate database and Metabase were left running.

corrected_attempt.outage_simulation: Paused only the candidate app container while the database and Metabase remained healthy.

docker_project_mismatch_recovery.incident: An initial rebuild command omitted -p kokonut-kernel-candidate and attempted a separate kokonut-intelligence Compose project; app startup failed because 127.0.0.1:8098 was already bound by the candidate.
docker_project_mismatch_recovery.cleanup: Removed only the failed app container and the three newly-created empty volumes plus network. Pre-existing legacy containers and volumes were not removed or restarted.
docker_project_mismatch_recovery.final_state: All three kokonut-kernel-candidate services healthy; legacy kokonut-intelligence containers remain exited.

verification.browser_acceptance: passed: one encrypted local record remained queued while the candidate app was paused, then background retry received HTTP 200 and cleared the queue after app restoration
verification.database_acceptance: one successful receipt and one transport-pending/ineligible collection before guarded cleanup; all fixture counts zero afterward
verification.candidate_services: app, database, and Metabase healthy after recovery

rollback: Revert the empty-field omission in services/mobile/field-collector.html and rebuild/recreate only the candidate app with the explicit -p kokonut-kernel-candidate project selector and the candidate edge overlays. No migration, seed, or lasting candidate data changed.
